summary: Retest for optimistic queue/ready updates executed on backend + mobile-web UI. Core ready-list optimistic behavior and ready-close rollback/completion worked; one code-level risk remains for outlet-specific dashboard cache updates.

ui_bugs.issue: Dikerjakan stat card has no dedicated testID, making deterministic mobile automation for count assertions brittle.

integration_issues.issue: UI shows ready order immediately via optimistic cache while backend can still be at previous stage for a short delay before queue sync flush succeeds (eventual consistency observed).

action_items: Make dashboard optimistic update outlet-scoped in /app/frontend/app/proses/[id].tsx (avoid broad queryKey ['dashboard']).
Add explicit testID for Dikerjakan stat card/value to support stable regression automation.
Optional: if strict consistency is required, await/confirm advance success before navigating away from proses->ready; current behavior is optimistic + eventual sync.
QRIS remains MOCKED and was not validated in this scope.
critical_code_review_comments: In /app/frontend/app/proses/[id].tsx, qc.setQueriesData({ queryKey: ['dashboard'] }) can touch all dashboard caches, not strictly the active outlet cache key ['dashboard', outletId].
closeOrder mutation in /app/frontend/app/siap-diambil.tsx correctly applies optimistic removal + dashboard decrement with rollback on error.
No negative queue counters observed; Math.max(0, ...) guards are present in optimistic updates.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (core optimistic + rollback + completion flows passed; one deterministic stat-card assertion gap due missing testID)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter19_ui_* and TEST_iter19_ready_* customer/order data via /app/tests/iter19_seed_ironing_order.py and /app/tests/iter19_seed_ready_order.py; cleaned using /app/tests/iter19_cleanup_test_data.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials used from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: Pegawai / pegawai123. Forced-failure rollback for ready close validated by intercepting POST /api/orders/{id}/advance with 500 once, card remained visible and backend stayed ready.
rca_of_issue: Outlet-specific risk RCA: proses/[id].tsx optimistic dashboard updater uses broad query prefix ['dashboard'] rather than ['dashboard', currentOutletId]. In multi-outlet cache scenarios this can update unrelated outlet counters. Mitigation: read session.currentOutletId and set/invalidate that exact key for optimistic mutation and rollback logic.
